name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Removes all ScriptApp trigger management from runtime; no script.scriptapp OAuth scope is required.
Control Center stays modeless and uses explicit google.script.run actions, which match Google Sheets authorization behavior better than long-running onEdit scans.
Single Group: select any cell on the Group row and click QUÉT DÒNG ĐANG CHỌN.
Multi Group: tick Chọn API, then QUÉT CÁC GROUP ĐÃ CHỌN / DỪNG / BỎ CHỌN from Control Center.
QUÉT NHÓM W:Z are now Chọn API, API trạng thái, API chi tiết, API Run; the previous per-cell command dropdown is repaired automatically.
Comment POC still rejects Group root URLs and requires a concrete post/permalink URL.
First-page POC remains in place while Group API response size/cursor behavior is being diagnosed.
